description:
Totals nutrients across several foods and assesses the meal.

assessment.shortfalls lists missed targets, worst first, and
assessment.over_limit lists exceeded limits. not_reported lists nutrients
with no data in the food records; those are unknown, not zero. failed
lists items left out of the total, and partial is true when there are any.

items.description: Foods in the meal, 1-25, each an fdc_id with grams, e.g. [{"fdc_id": 168462, "grams": 150}].

name: analyze_meal
title: Analyze a meal
